resources.string: On Kim Biseo on your PC, go to Settings → Phone connection → Create connection code. A QR code and an 8-digit number will appear. Your phone and PC must be on the same Wi-Fi, or both must have Tailscale enabled.
Enter the PC address (shown under Create connection code on your PC).
That is a public internet address. Use a home address (such as 192.168.x.x) or a Tailscale address (100.x.x.x).
That isn\'t a valid PC address. Enter a home address like 192.168.x.x or a Tailscale address (100.x.x.x) using digits and dots.
The certificate code is the 16 characters (digits and A–F) shown on your PC. Spaces don\'t matter.
Only paired phones can talk to Kim Biseo on your PC. Conversations are encrypted within your home network, and this app sends nothing to any other server.
Connect only if it matches the certificate code on your PC screen. If it differs, another device may be impersonating your PC.
Connected to %1$s. Tap Start talking and speak.
Point your camera at the QR code on your PC screen
This QR code isn\'t a Kim Biseo connection code.
Tap Start talking and speak, or type below. Examples: What\'s the weather in Seoul tomorrow? · Directions to Gangnam Station · Search today\'s news on Naver.
Microphone permission is needed to talk by voice.
Kim Biseo %1$s · PC control %2$s · Enrolled voice only %3$s
Kim Biseo greets you when a chat starts

PC control (search, websites, opening apps, Notepad) and Accept commands only from my enrolled voice are turned on or off in Kim Biseo settings on your PC. For hard-to-undo actions like deleting or sending, this phone asks \"Run it?\" first.
This only clears connection info on this phone. To remove it from the PC list too, go to PC Settings → Phone connection → Connected phones and tap Delete.
Kim Biseo phone app %1$s · HighLife PC
Show the pet on the chat screen
Turn this off to stop pet videos and save battery. Downloaded clips stay on the phone.
Clips are not downloaded over mobile data. Clips already downloaded still play.
Choose a pet for this phone
Pick one of the outfits on your PC to use on this phone only.
Getting pet info from your PC…
Pet clips will download when you connect to Wi-Fi.
The PC has no pet outfit yet. Get a pet outfit in Kim Biseo on the PC first.
Could not download pet clips. Check the connection to your PC.
%1$d pet clips are saved on this phone (%2$s).
Interpreter is available during a chat. Start talking, then turn it on here or say \"Interpret into English.\"
Interpreter is turned off in your PC settings.
The other person\'s speech is only translated. To turn it off, say \"Stop interpreting\" or tap Off.
Only your enrolled voice can turn it on or off.
Kim Biseo on your PC is listening
No microphone permission, so the chat couldn\'t start.
The PC certificate differs from when you paired. If you changed PCs, pair again.
This phone was removed from the PC. Please connect again.
The PC isn\'t accepting this connection. If you\'re away from home, check that Kim Biseo on your PC has Settings → Phone connection → Accept Tailscale connections turned on.
Not your enrolled voice, so it wasn\'t heard
Taking a break. Tap Start talking to speak again.
The chat moved to the PC screen or another phone, so this session ended.
No answer, so it wasn\'t run.
Couldn\'t open the microphone. You can chat by text.
Reading the page on your PC
Typing in Notepad on your PC
The PC certificate doesn\'t match the pairing code fingerprint. Check that the certificate code you entered matches the one on your PC screen.
Too many wrong codes, so it\'s temporarily locked. Try again in %1$s.
Too many wrong codes, so the PC temporarily blocked connections (up to 15 minutes). Try again later with a new code from your PC.
The connection code doesn\'t match the number on your PC. Check the 8 digits again.
The connection code expired (10 minutes). On your PC, tap Create connection code again for a new code.
There\'s no usable connection code on the PC right now (it was used or never created). Tap Create connection code on your PC.
The PC isn\'t accepting Tailscale connections. In Kim Biseo on your PC, go to Settings → Phone connection and turn on Accept Tailscale connections, then save.
The PC didn\'t accept a connection from this phone\'s address. Check that your phone and PC are on the same home Wi-Fi.
The connection code is wrong or expired. Create a new code on your PC.
The PC couldn\'t accept the connection (response %1$d). Try restarting Kim Biseo on your PC.
Couldn\'t reach the PC (%1$s). Check: ① Tailscale on your phone shows Connected ② Tailscale is also on for your PC ③ Kim Biseo is running on the PC and Settings → Phone connection is on.

Couldn\'t reach the PC. Check: ① your phone and PC are on the same Wi-Fi (away from home, turn on Tailscale on both and use the PC\'s 100.x address) ② Kim Biseo is running on the PC and Settings → Phone connection is on.
This app doesn\'t recognize that task.
Couldn\'t open it on your phone (%1$s).
%1$s Tap the phone notification to open it.
Couldn\'t open a map app or a web browser on your phone.
There\'s no name to send to.
Contacts permission is needed to open the phone or message screen by name
Allow contacts permission on your phone. An Allow button appears in the Kim Biseo app.
There are several names similar to \'%1$s\'.
That doesn\'t look like a phone number.
Put %1$s into the phone screen. Press the call button yourself.
Opened the message screen for %1$s. Press Send yourself.
Couldn\'t find the \'%1$s\' app on your phone.
Couldn\'t open the \'%1$s\' app or a browser on your phone.
%1$s opened \'%2$s\'. Tap Add to cart or Order yourself.
%1$s on the web opened \'%2$s\'. Tap Add to cart or Order yourself.
The search words \'%2$s\' are copied. Opening %1$s — paste them into the search box. Tap Add to cart or Order yourself.
Tap Directions in the search results
Choose the destination in the search results
Tap Route in the search results
The destination name is copied — paste it into the search box
How would you like to use it?
You can use it without a PC. You can change this later in Settings.
Talk to Kim Biseo on your PC and work with its files and apps. Both must be on the same Wi-Fi, or both must use Tailscale.
Talk to a small AI that runs on this phone, with no PC. Download the model once and it works offline. No account or key needed.
This phone cannot use standalone mode: %1$s
You can change this anytime in Settings.
Switch to using just this phone
Switch to standalone mode? Your PC pairing and chat history stay.
Switch if you want to talk only to the on-phone AI. If you have not downloaded the model yet, download it first.
Downloaded from Google\'s official source (Hugging Face litert-community) and stored only in this app\'s storage. Once downloaded, it works without internet.
Model: Gemma 4 E2B · Apache License 2.0 (gemma.ai/resources/apache-2) · Engine: LiteRT-LM · Apache License 2.0
I have read the above and agree to download the model.
Please turn on the agreement first.
You can now chat without internet.
It will download when you connect to Wi-Fi. You are on mobile data now.
The downloaded file does not match the official file. Please delete and download again.
Download stopped. You can resume next time.
Delete the model (about 2.6GB) from this phone? Chat history stays.
The model is not here. Please download it first.
Loading the model… (about 10 seconds the first time)
This phone has 4GB of RAM, which is a bit tight. Closing other apps while the model loads and you chat keeps things more stable.
Other apps are using too much memory, so the model could not load. Close other apps and try again, or switch to PC connection mode.
Ask me anything. This conversation stays on this phone.
Still answering. Please send again when it finishes.
Clear the chat history and start over?
Changes the screen, instructions, speech recognition, and voice language. Replies use the language you speak.
Uses your phone\'s built-in TTS. Some languages may not have a voice installed.
Speech recognition uses your phone\'s built-in recognizer. It works offline if an offline language pack is installed.
No speech recognition is available on this phone. Please type instead.
This phone has no matching voice, so replies cannot be read aloud.
Could not do it on your phone: %1$s
Switch to the PC connection screen? The on-phone model and chat history stay.
Switch to PC connection mode to talk to Kim Biseo on your PC and control it.
This is a small on-phone AI, so replies can be slow or wrong. Please verify important information. Chats are stored only on this phone.
Kim Biseo phone app %1$s · standalone mode
